headline: Unable to Pay Bank Credit Rp10,23 M, RUNS Sells Building Asset
summary: PT Global Sukses Solusi (RUNS) will auction land and building assets to settle its debt. The company projects a significant increase in cash and working capital.
why: Asset sales by indebted listed companies in Indonesia are closely watched by investors assessing balance-sheet stress and recovery prospects.
original_headline: Tak Bisa Bayar Kredit Bank Rp10,23 M, RUNS Lepas Aset Gedung
